image_description: A close-up portrait of a bald man with glasses against a blue background. He has several adhesive bandages applied to his face: one on his forehead, one on the bridge of his nose, and a larger cluster on his left cheek. The bandages appear to be standard beige/tan fabric type with white central pads.

The bandage on the forehead and the one on the nose clearly exhibit the classic narrow rectangular shape with rounded ends typical of this product class.

artifact_observations.location: Bandage on the bridge of the nose
artifact_observations.reasoning: The bandage on the nose seems to merge into the glasses frame and the skin in an unnatural way. The geometry of how it wraps over the nasal bridge is ambiguous and lacks clear depth separation from the glasses.

The background appears to be a composite or generated landscape with a horizon line that doesn't quite align with the lighting on the subject, creating a slight spatial disconnect, though this is less critical to the object class itself.
